observed_because: An observed question runs on all three topologies and is compared when it answers, but need not answer; a failure that is no refusal fails the run on any question. Nine read an unfiltered part leg, which at SF10 is 2,000,000 rows, exactly two streams of 1,000,000. A split leg is cut by pages, not rows, so a partition can be past the bound. Run 42342552818 measured it: ONE refused all nine as result_too_large, and on MANY a reader logged that a granted partition did not fit its per-stream bound for each of the nine, so MANY refused all nine as result_too_large and none answered. revenue-by-customer-and-supplier-region over seven years has a fact leg of about 60,000,000 rows, grouped by both links, which does not fit the working set: in that run ONE and MANY both refused it as result_too_large, MANY on the serving node's volume bound, so its 1995 sibling is the listed one. Promote a question to questions once a run shows it answers.
